name: Timeline Entry
description: Immutable entry in an append-only Timeline. The Timeline Provider assigns sequence and timestamp, links the entry to its predecessor, and authenticates actor attribution. A feeder validates, orders, and filters entries before passing eligible events to a processor.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing position of this entry within its timeline.

prevEntry.description: Previous entry in the same timeline, normally represented as a pure reference. The first entry may omit this field.

timestamp.description: Microsecond timestamp assigned by the Timeline Provider. The provider must preserve its timeline and completeness semantics for this value.

actor.description: Actor attributed as the writer or submitter of this entry.

onBehalfOf.description: Optional mandate-backed authority under which actor claims to act for another actor. A feeder validates this authority before delivery when the requested action is not directly eligible through a source channel.

message.description: Message or event recorded by the entry.
